## Solver summary (unchanged from prior verified result)
Structure-aware recursive factorization of `n·(a·S(n)−b)=c` with multiplicative `S(n)=sigma(n)/n`: exact r=1 completion, exact single-prime completion `q=(A−c)/(B−A)` (Miller–Rabin), exact prime-power completions `q^e`, degenerate `A==B==c` identity case (all primes; segmented sieve), and deeper factorization only for intermediate primes bounded by `q≤sqrt(U/m)` plus an `S(m)·S(q)<cap` headroom cap. All arithmetic exact (`fractions.Fraction` / big ints) — no precision loss.
